commit.message:
fix(load-tests): calibrate gas on a warm transaction per type (#6170)

* fix(load-tests): calibrate gas on a warm transaction per type

The first calibration transaction pays one-time costs, such as a B-20 recipient's first balance write (+17,100 gas), that the run amortizes away, so pacing offered more gas than landed.

Co-authored-by: Toshi <toshi-noreply@coinbase.com>

* fix(load-tests): read the calibration nonce from the submission node

A query node that lags the submission node can return the nonce the
previous calibration round already used, failing the run with nonce too
low. Calibration submits and confirms on the submission node, so read
the nonce there too. The test now queries a node that never sees the
calibration transactions.

---------

Co-authored-by: Toshi <toshi-noreply@coinbase.com>
